name: cortex-game-engine
description: Motor de jogo 3D com ECS, Three.js e integração com Claude AI

scripts.build:engine: tsc -p tsconfig.engine.json && vite build --config vite.engine.config.ts && vite build --config vite.engine.dev.config.ts
scripts.electron:dev: yarn build:engine && yarn docs:engine && electron-vite dev
scripts.electron:build: yarn build:engine && yarn docs:engine && electron-vite build && electron-builder
scripts.build:web: cd web && yarn install && yarn build && cd ..
